name: Gradiente Temporal
algorithm: Temporal Gradient — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal gradient patterns for video deepfake detection:

1. **Temporal Gradiente Cálculo**: The frame-to-frame difference (temporal gradient) I_t(x,y) = I(x,y,t+1) − I(x,y,t) is computed for each pixel. This captures the instantaneous rate of change of image intensity over time.

2. **Temporal Gradiente Statistics**: The distribution of temporal gradient values is analyzed. Natural video shows specific gradient distributions: approximately Laplacian with width depending on motion speed. The method detects anomalous gradient distributions — too narrow (overly stable, suggesting generated smoothing) or too wide (excessive temporal variation).

3. **Espacial - Temporal Gradiente Relationship**: The relationship between spatial gradients (edges) and temporal gradients (motion) should follow the optical flow constraint equation: I_x·u + I_y·v + I_t = 0. The method checks this constraint. Generated video may violate the brightness constancy assumption in ways inconsistent with any physical motion.

4. **Rostro - Background Gradiente Comparación**: Temporal gradient statistics of face and background regions are compared. In authentic video from a single camera, both show similar temporal noise characteristics. Deepfakes may show different temporal gradient statistics in the face (from the generation process) compared to the background (from the camera).

5. **Temporal Gradiente Map Análisis**: A map of temporal gradient magnitude reveals which regions change most between frames. In authentic video, high-gradient regions correspond to moving objects and edges. Deepfake artifacts may produce elevated temporal gradients at face boundaries, blending zones, or throughout the generated face due to per-frame rendering inconsistency.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante temporal gradient analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
